svg.aria-label: Objeck toolchain architecture with pending 2026.11.4 features
svg.text: From the editor to five platforms: one compiler front end serves obc and the language server; the VM interprets, then JIT-compiles hot methods.
the compiler's own front end as a native
library, so editor errors match obc
source (.obs) to a program (.obe) or a library (.obl)
interprets, then compiles hot methods to native code
I/O · sockets · threads · time · reflection; loads a library's
C++ module on first call; unloads them at exit
lang and collections link by default; name the rest with -lib
libraries agent, mcp and mcp_agent: Objeck functions as tools for a model, or served as an MCP server
Native modules (C++) and the code they wrap
bundled with each release, or supplied by the platform
Build, test and release · GitHub Actions
at one commit before a tag
Landing in 2026.11.4 (open pull requests, not yet merged)
